ecosystem.title: The financial ecosystem for your business
ecosystem.subtitle: Manage your money with freedom: pay, save and invest without complications.

cards.title: Do business with the world, same day

popup.heading: Connect your business with the world
intro: Boldness to do business without borders. Kapital FX gives you the ecosystem to operate in other currencies, pay international suppliers and move at the pace of the global market.
bullets: Buy and transfer currencies with full control
Fast, 100% digital execution
Competitive and transparent prices, no surprises
popup.closing: The financial ecosystem for companies that dare to operate beyond the known. Move money between countries with clarity, speed and expert support.

cards.title: Send dollars to any company, in seconds

popup.heading: Send dollars to any company, in seconds
intro: SPID allows you to move dollars between companies in Mexico instantly, without conversions or correspondent banks.
bullets: Transfer dollars to any authorized bank in Mexico
Pay suppliers in USD without converting to pesos
Operate same day, during banking hours
popup.closing: Everything you need to operate in dollars, in one place and without leaving Mexico.

cards.title: Pay your supplier today and negotiate in your favor

popup.heading: Streamline your payments without affecting your cash flow
intro: A revolving credit line to pay your suppliers without compromising your liquidity.
Kapital Bank pays for you instantly and you pay in 1, 2, 3, 6, 9 or 12 months.
bullets: Negotiate early payment discounts
Always have inventory available
Don't stop your operations due to lack of cash flow
popup.closing: Extend your payment terms without affecting your cash flow and, by always paying on time, strengthen your negotiating power with suppliers.

cards.title: Collect today what you've already sold

popup.heading: Don't wait 90 days, collect your invoices today
intro: Advance the collection of invoices and turn them into available cash today.
This keeps your operations active, with constant cash flow and without depending on your clients' payment schedule.
bullets: Receive immediate liquidity for your business.
Reduce the risk of non-payment.
Collect multiple invoices at once.
popup.closing: Make your company grow at its own pace, not your clients'. Collect today what you've already sold.

popup.heading: Simple financing tailored to you
intro: An agile and accessible solution for small and medium-sized businesses that need capital to keep operating, grow or get out of a tight spot.
Apply from $50,000 MXN to pay payroll, buy inventory or invest in your business.
bullets: Use the capital freely, according to your business priorities. Apply once and use it when you need it.
Once approved, your money arrives in 24 hours.
popup.closing: Finance the essentials and focus on what matters: growing your business.

popup.heading: No more pauses: finance your decision today
intro: A financing solution made for businesses that need to strengthen their operations, invest or expand.
Get up to $50 million pesos to boost your project and take your company to the next level.
bullets: Use the capital for whatever your business needs
Access clear terms
Strengthen your finances with planned payments
popup.closing: Get the capital your business needs, when it needs it.

cards.title: Make your money work for you

popup.heading: Invest strategically, earn every month
intro: An investment designed for companies that want profitability without losing liquidity.
From $10,000 MXN, you choose the term and receive fixed returns every month.
bullets: Receive interest every month, without waiting until the end of the term.
Invest for 90, 120, 180, 240 or up to 360 days.
Earn up to 9.00%* return at 360 days with no hidden clauses.
popup.closing: Make your liquidity generate income without pauses. A simple, profitable investment at your own pace.
popup.cta: I want to invest in CDs

cards.title: All your operations, in one place

popup.heading: Manage your business from one place
intro: The digital platform that allows you to manage finances and operate your company in real time: accounts, payments, income, expenses and suppliers.
Get the visibility you need. Maximum clarity for better decisions.
bullets: View and manage your business accounts.
Control your income, expenses and invoices.
Automate recurring payments and avoid delays.
popup.closing: Manage your company with the clarity you always needed.

accountHighlight.title: Your money, free and always at hand
accountHighlight.description: Open your account from $1,000 MXN and manage your money easily with a debit card and instant SPEI.

items.title: Invest from anywhere
items.body: Access Promissory Notes and CDs directly in the Kapital app, and put your company's money to work with attractive returns and the term you choose.

items.title: Total control
items.body: Receive, pay, transfer and withdraw from one place. Monitor your transactions in real time, receive notifications and take control of your finances.

items.title: Security
items.body: Authorize transactions with a unique token from your app, with encrypted and confidential transmission. Enjoy safer, faster and easier banking.

items.title: Hassle-free finances
items.body: Open your account in 5 minutes, receive deposits of up to $25,000 MXN and an international debit card to shop, withdraw and check your balance wherever you are.

items.title: Services and taxes
items.body: Access your accounts and make transactions wherever you are. Schedule payments for services, loans or cards, and enjoy your bank available 24/7.

items.title: Products tailored to you
items.body: View, review conditions and contract products in minutes from the Kapital app, without affecting your operations.

applePay.title: Privacy. Security. That's Apple Pay.
applePay.description: Apple Pay uses security features built into your Apple device, such as Face ID and Touch ID. It's designed so only you can authorize payments with your Kapital card.

legal.ratesDisclaimer: *Rates are annual and fixed during the investment term, subject to prevailing conditions at the time of contracting. Check the offer validity, requirements and information about contracting or product features at kapital.com. Gross annual fixed rate 8.50% GROSS APY 8.50% and REAL APY 4.15%, before taxes, calculated as of August 27, 2026 on an investment range of $1,000.00 MXN to $49,999.99 MXN, for a 360-day term, valid until September 30, 2026. For informational and comparison purposes. Real APY is the return you would obtain after deducting estimated inflation. Contracting is subject to compliance with client profile and eligibility conditions available at kapital.com
legal.clientProfile: Client Profile and Eligibility: This promotional rate for the PRLV product (Promissory Note with Return Payable at Maturity) has been designed exclusively for retail investors, including individuals, individuals with business activity and legal entities (SMEs) seeking to optimize their cash flow through guaranteed savings instruments.
legal.eligibility: Eligibility: The offer is available to clients whose investment profile is compatible with this product. In order to maintain the sustainability of this promotional rate, this offer is not aimed at Development Banking institutions, Multiple Banking, other financial entities (public or private), or foreign institutions, as this product is not designed for institutional treasury operations or over-the-counter transactions between financial entities.
